question: Which of the following is a district-cum-tourism hotspot of Arunachal Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Tawang.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Tawang** is a district-cum-tourism hotspot of **Arunachal Pradesh**.
 
• **Alipurdaur, Jalpaiguri and Kalimpong **are the tourist places of the state **West Bengal**.
